description: Create or replace an Actions variable (plain text, not for secrets — use gluecron_set_repo_secret). Pass owner + repo for a repository variable, owner + repo + environment for an environment variable, or org for an organisation variable (organisation variables need an admin-scoped token). Safe to retry: the same value again changes nothing. Audit-logged. Returns {name, effect: created|updated|unchanged, updatedAt}.

name.description: Variable name: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit or GITHUB_ (stored upper-case)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug (omit when passing org)

value.description: Plain-text value (not a secret: shown on the settings page and in logs), at most 48 KB

name: gluecron_set_variable
